# Shandal Geological Field Survey System (نظام شندل للمسح الميداني الجيولوجي)

> A digital survey system that turns a smartphone into a geological and engineering field station, designed and built by Iraqi geologist Ali Shandal Al-Janabi.
> نظام رقمي يحوّل الهاتف الذكي إلى محطة مسح جيولوجية وهندسية، صممه وبناه الجيولوجي العراقي علي شندل الجنابي.

Website: https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/ (English) · https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/ar/ (العربية)
Also called: Shandal System, Shandal Geo, نظام شندل.
Founder and designer: Ali Shandal Al-Janabi (علي شندل الجنابي), Iraqi geologist specialising in remote sensing and geophysics, Baghdad, Iraq.
Founded: 2025 · Official launch: 5 April 2026 · Registered as a scientific work no. 2841/ع at the Iraqi National Centre for Protection of Copyright and Related Rights (13 April 2026).
Contact: WhatsApp +9647739949727 · Facebook https://www.facebook.com/Shandalsystem · YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@shandalsystem
Updated: 2026-11-10

## What it is
Sixty-three professional tools for Earth scientists: digital compass, stereonets, RMR and SMR, global contour maps, seismic hazard statistics, soil mechanics, Sentinel-2 indices, live hazard feeds and petroleum labs, with PDF reports and an AI assistant.
For decades, field geology meant scattered tools: readings taken by hand, long calculations, then a return to the office to draw columns, stereonets and contour maps in separate software. Every step cost time and added room for error.
The Shandal System brings that work into one portable tool, from the first reading to the final report, without leaving the site. The name says what it does: survey, to collect spatial data precisely; field, because it goes where the geologist goes.

## ما هو
ثلاث وستون أداة احترافية لعلماء الأرض: بوصلة رقمية ومساقط ستيريوغرافية وRMR وخرائط كنتورية وأطياف تصميم زلزالي وإنذار من الانزلاقات ورصد بيئي ومختبرات بترولية، مع تقارير PDF ومساعد ذكي.
لعقود طويلة كان العمل الجيولوجي الميداني يعتمد على أدوات متفرقة: قياسات يدوية وحسابات طويلة ثم العودة إلى المكتب لرسم الأعمدة الطباقية والمساقط والخرائط الكنتورية ببرامج منفصلة. كل خطوة تستهلك الوقت وتزيد احتمال الخطأ.
جاء نظام شندل ليجمع هذا العمل في أداة محمولة واحدة، من القراءة الأولى حتى التقرير النهائي، دون مغادرة الموقع. والاسم يعبّر عن جوهره: «المسح» لجمع البيانات المكانية بدقة، و«الميداني» لأنه يرافق الجيولوجي حيث يعمل.

## Tools (63)
### Field geology · الجيولوجيا الميدانية
- [Unit Converter · محوّل الوحدات](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/unit-converter/): Converts between all common units of 30 quantities with the exact factors of the international standards: length, area (including the Iraqi dunam and olk), volume and barrels, mass and carats, density, API gravity and mud weight, pressure and stress, pressure and geothermal gradients, temperature, angle, dip and slope in percent and ratio, time and geological time, speed and sonic slowness, gravity in milligal, force, energy, power, flow, permeability in darcy, hydraulic conductivity, viscosity, concentration, resistivity, conductivity and salinity, magnetic field in nanotesla, radioactivity and dose, frequency, data and fuel. It also converts coordinates between decimal degrees, degrees–minutes–seconds and UTM, works out map scales, and turns ions between mg/L and meq/L with the ionic balance. Free for everyone.
- [Iraq Time Machine · آلة الزمن للعراق](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/iraq-time-machine/): Travel from the Cambrian to today and watch the plates move Iraq from near the South Pole to its place now. At every moment the tool shows the latitude of Baghdad, the climate belt and the distance travelled since, the setting that covered Iraq (sea, reef, lagoon, delta, river or ice), the story of that interval and the formations being laid down. An interactive stratigraphic column of more than ninety formations links each one to its age, rocks, setting, importance (oil reservoir, source, seal, aquifer, mineral resource) and the places where it can be seen.
- [Site Report · التقرير الشامل للموقع](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/site-report/): One click gathers what a geologist or engineer needs to know about a place before the first field visit: coordinates in three systems, elevation, slope, aspect, relief and position in the landscape with two ground profiles; the mapped geological unit with its age, rocks and engineering character; the active faults around it with the largest magnitude they could produce and the nearest plate boundary; every instrumental earthquake of magnitude 4 and above since 1973 with rates and 50-year chances; the nearest Holocene volcano; 30-year climate normals with the Köppen–Geiger class and the aridity index; soil texture, pH and organic carbon by depth; and the nearest rivers with the height of the site above them. A screening matrix rates seven hazards and a checklist says what to test in the field. The whole report downloads as a PDF with a verification code.
- [Field Station: Position, Compass and the Ground Around You · المحطة الحقلية: الموقع والبوصلة والأرض من حولك](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/field-station/): A complete field station on the phone. The position is averaged from many satellite readings and given in degrees, degrees–minutes–seconds and UTM, with the elevation above sea level. The compass and clinometer work in three holds: flat (the direction of the top edge, with a level bubble), upright (the direction the camera looks and its tilt) and laid on the bed (dip, dip direction and strike), in magnetic and true north; readings are locked, recorded and sent to the stereonet. The station sheet adds the weather for 24 hours with the hour rain or a storm is expected, heat, frost, gusts and sunset; the nearest road, track, river, stream, spring, village, named peak and cave with distance and bearing; the geological unit underfoot and around with the colours, rocks, fossils and features of the Iraqi formations; groundwater indications; and the nearest active faults, on a map and a one-page station card.
- [Outcrop Sketch and Field Description · رسم المنكشف والوصف الحقلي](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/outcrop-sketch/): The field sketch is the oldest tool of the geologist and still the best record of an outcrop. Here it is drawn on a photo of the face or on a blank sheet: bed boundaries, faults, joints and veins are traced with a finger, fossils, samples and dip notes are placed with a tap, and the scale is set from an object of known length. The beds between the boundaries are numbered from the base and described with lithology, colour, grain size, bedding thickness, veins, fossils, joints, sedimentary and tectonic structures and landform. The thickness of each bed is measured on the picture. The result is an annotated sketch and a measured section (log) with lithology patterns and grain-size widths, a bed table and a project file.
- [Field Survey Companion · مرافق المسح الحقلي](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/field-companion/): Records a field traverse station by station: an averaged GPS position, lithology, formation and description, bedding, joints, faults, foliation, veins and lineations typed or read from the phone held on the rock and corrected to true north, numbered samples and photos kept on the device. It works without a connection after the first visit, and when the connection returns every station is completed with its place name, ground elevation and mapped geological unit. It draws the station map, a traverse plan to scale with strike-and-dip symbols and a stereonet of all measurements, builds a photo sheet and a PDF field report, exports CSV, GeoJSON and KML, and sends the measurements to the Stereonet Lab and any station to the Site Report.
- [Geological Field Trips · الرحلات الجيولوجية الحقلية](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/field-trips/): A field guide inside the system. Each trip has its stops on a map with their coordinates, the formations exposed with age and lithology, the structures to see, the measurements to take, the fossils that may be found and the safety notes, together with the stratigraphic column of everything seen on the trip. The phone’s position shows the nearest stop and its distance and bearing, and each stop opens the field companion, the stereonet or a ready cross-section line. The first trip runs from Baghdad to Sulaymaniyah by Kirkuk and back by Darbandikhan and the Diyala valley.
- [What Is in Front of Me? Geology Camera · ماذا أمامي؟ الكاميرا الجيولوجية](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/geo-eye/): Combines the phone’s position, compass and tilt with an elevation model and the geological map. The line of sight is traced through the terrain to the point you are looking at, and the unit there is named with its age, lithology and distance; a strip across the picture shows the units from left to right and the computed skyline is drawn so the compass can be checked. A location sheet gives the elevation, slope, landform, the unit underfoot and around, the local succession, the fossils to look for and the nearest active fault, with a 360° panorama of the units on the skyline. Areas can be saved on the phone beforehand so everything works without a network.
- [Quarry & Earthworks Survey · مسح المقالع واستثمار التراب](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/quarry-survey/): Converts contract areas and field measurements into extracted and remaining volumes, maximum permitted depth, a 2D site plan and a stratigraphic column for the pit face.
- [Structural & Geotechnical Survey · المسح التركيبي والجيوتقني](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/structural-geotechnical/): Field survey of a rock slope: orientation data from the phone compass-clinometer, kinematic analysis of planar, wedge and toppling failure, limit-equilibrium factors of safety, RMR89 and SMR classification, a geological plan and section, and the stratigraphic column of the outcrop.
- [Stereonet Lab · مختبر المسقط الستيريوغرافي](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/stereonet-lab/): Analyses any number of planes and lines measured in the field or with the phone: pole density contours, Fisher statistics of each set, eigenvalue fabric and π-girdle axis, rose diagram of strikes, and the percentage of measurements critical for planar, wedge and toppling failure against a slope face.
- [Stratigraphic Column Designer · مصمم العمود الطباقي](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/strata/): Draws stratigraphic columns in the layout used in journals and basin studies: ICS chronostratigraphy, group and formation, depth scale, FGDC lithology patterns, unconformities and hiatuses, depositional environment and petroleum-system elements, followed by an automatic stratigraphic description and interpretation.
- [World Faults and Plates · الفوالق والصفائح العالمية](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/faults-plates/): An atlas of 9 600 active faults and of the boundaries of 56 tectonic plates. Each fault opens with its type of movement, dip and dip direction, rake, slip rate, seismogenic depth, length and trend; each plate boundary with its type (subduction, collision, rift, spreading ridge, transform) and its relative velocity. Tap any point for the plate beneath it and its velocity, draw an area for counts, lengths and a rose diagram with the Rayleigh test, and download a framed map, GeoJSON, KML or CSV.
- [Geological Unit Finder · مستكشف الوحدات الجيولوجية](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/geologic-unit/): Identifies the geological units mapped under any point on Earth from Macrostrat’s integrated global geological map, at every available map scale, with age, lithology, depositional setting and source map; places them on the international time scale, builds the local stratigraphic succession and writes a geological description and interpretation of the site.
- [Automatic Geological Cross-Section · المقطع الجيولوجي الآلي](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/geo-section/): Builds a geological cross-section along any line: the topographic profile from a global elevation model, the geological units cut by the line with their exact contacts and ages, strike-and-dip measurements from the field or typed in projected onto the section with their apparent dip, and a subsurface constructed from the contacts by the rule that beds dip towards younger strata. Units, ages and dips can be edited, and the section is drawn as a finished figure with vertical exaggeration, scale and legend.
- [Iraq’s Mineral Wealth · ثروات العراق](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/iraq-resources/): An atlas of six of Iraq’s main earth resources. For each one it maps the fields, mines, plants and producing areas, explains the geology of the host formations and their ages, gives the latest published reserves, capacities and production with their year, and sets out the uses inside Iraq and in the world economy, with the main challenges and opportunities. Each resource has its own printable map and chart.
- [Fossil Sites Explorer · مستكشف مواقع الأحافير](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/fossils/): Finds the published fossil sites of any area and interprets them inside Shandal: the rocks, formation, depositional environment, age and ancient latitude of each site, every fossil found there with its description, photographs, time range and worldwide record, a written reading of the whole region, and print-ready maps, figures and tables.
- [Geo-Heritage & Archaeological Tourism · السياحة الجيولوجية والآثارية](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/geoheritage/): An atlas of 164 natural, geological, archaeological, religious and museum places in Iraq with the geology beneath each, surface rock, elevation, live weather, photographs, nearby places, a trip planner and directions in the navigation app you choose.

### Remote sensing · التحسس النائي
- [Earth Through Time: Every Year Since 1972 · الأرض عبر الزمن: كل سنة منذ 1972](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/iraq-timelapse/): Pick a place in Iraq (the marshes, Lake Sawa, Razzaza, the Mosul, Haditha or Dukan lakes, Baghdad, Erbil, Basra) or in the world (the Aral Sea, Lake Urmia, the Dead Sea, the Atatürk Dam lake, Dubai, Cairo, Lake Mead, the Columbia Glacier, the Amazon in Rondônia, Shanghai, Lake Poopó), search any place by name, or draw any area on Earth. For every year from 1972 to today the tool takes the clearest Landsat scene of the same season, crops it to the area, measures open water and green vegetation on every pixel with its true ground area, and builds framed map frames with coordinates, north arrow, scale and legend. It draws the curves of water and vegetation through the years, maps what was lost and gained between any two years, and records the whole story as a video in landscape, square or vertical reel format.
- [Land Cover Change and Urban Growth · تغير الغطاء الأرضي والتوسع العمراني](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/landcover-change/): Choose a city or any area up to 100 km across and two years. The tool reads the annual global land-cover maps at 10 m, made from Sentinel-2 by a deep-learning model, and measures the area of water, trees, crops, built area, bare ground and rangeland in every year with the true ground area of each pixel. Between the two years it builds the full table of what became what, maps the main changes (farmland to buildings, other land to buildings, farmland lost, new farmland, water lost and gained, trees lost) and can count a change only when it holds in the following year, which removes most of the year-to-year flicker of the maps.
- [Sentinel-2 Spectral Indices · المؤشرات الطيفية لـ Sentinel-2](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/spectral-indices/): Finds Sentinel-2 Level-2A scenes over your area, renders spectral indices such as NDVI, NDWI, NDBI, NBR and the clay, ferrous and iron-oxide mineral ratios as map layers, computes area statistics, and compares two dates to measure change.
- [Lineament Extraction · استخراج الخطيات](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/lineament-extraction/): Draw an area and the tool reads a 30 m elevation model, lights it from four directions, finds the edges with the Canny detector, thins and traces them, and links collinear pieces across short gaps into continuous lineaments. Each lineament is classed as a linear valley, ridge, scarp or slope line from the elevations on both sides, with its relief, width, downthrown side, length class and indicative depth reach; the rock units on its two sides are compared to flag possible fault contacts. Rose diagram, density, Rayleigh test and comparison with active faults follow, with a framed map and GeoJSON, KML, CSV and density-grid downloads.
- [Mineral Prospectivity · الاحتمالية المعدنية](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/mineral-prospectivity/): Draw an area and the tool ranks where hydrothermal alteration, structures and favourable host rock coincide: clay–hydroxyl, iron-oxide and ferrous-silicate anomalies from Sentinel-2 with vegetation, fields, water and towns masked, host-rock favourability, distance to lineaments and lineament density. The layers are weighted by the analytic hierarchy process and the map is checked against known occurrences.
- [ASTER Mineral Mapping · الكشف المعدني الطيفي بصور ASTER](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/aster-minerals/): ASTER is the satellite sensor made for geology: six short-wave infrared bands catch the absorption features of clays, micas, carbonates, sulphates and chlorite, and five thermal bands those of quartz, carbonates and gypsum. Choose an area, find an image and a mineral index: ferric and ferrous iron, AlOH group (clays, micas, alunite), kaolin, FeOH, MgOH and carbonate, gypsum, silica, quartz and carbonate in the thermal range, or an RGB of AlOH, MgOH and ferric content. Vegetation and water are masked, the index is stretched and mapped, the strongest part of the rock surface is outlined on the image as anomalies with their area, and the result is exported as maps, polygons and numbers.
- [Archaeological Site Potential · احتمالية المواقع الأثرية](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/archaeo-potential/): Draw an area and the tool ranks where ancient settlement is likely from seven evidence layers: mound (tell) relief, distance to water, height above the nearest drainage, slope, dry-season soil-brightness anomalies, spring crop-mark anomalies and land cover. The layers are weighted by the analytic hierarchy process, the map is generalised to about 1 km to protect unrecorded sites, and it is checked against the sites already recorded in the area.

### Engineering & geotechnics · الهندسة والجيوتقنية
- [Rock Mass Classification Lab · مختبر تصنيف الكتلة الصخرية](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/rockmass-lab/): Rates a rock mass with the three international classification systems, derives GSI, and converts it into the Hoek–Brown strength envelope, equivalent Mohr–Coulomb cohesion and friction angle, and the rock-mass modulus, for slopes or tunnels.
- [Seismic Evaluation & Building Code · التقييم السيزمي والكود الهندسي](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/seismic-evaluation/): Applies ASCE 7-16 site coefficients to the mapped accelerations, builds the design response spectrum, assigns the seismic design category, computes the equivalent-lateral-force base shear, maps nearby active faults with a deterministic scenario, and checks liquefaction with the Youd et al. (2001) method.
- [Seismic Hazard Explorer · مستكشف الخطر الزلزالي](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/seismic-hazard/): Retrieves the instrumental earthquake catalogue around any site, fits the Gutenberg–Richter law, and estimates annual rates, return periods and the probability of exceedance over a design life, with plate boundaries on the map.
- [Global Soil Properties · خصائص التربة العالمية](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/soil-properties/): Characterises the soil at any point and over a study area: properties at six depths to 2 m with their prediction intervals, USDA texture, water retention, WRB soil group probabilities, the nearest measured soil profiles, and publication-ready maps of the properties chosen for the purpose of the study.
- [Bearing Capacity of Shallow Foundations · قدرة تحمل الأسس الضحلة](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/bearing-capacity/): Calculates ultimate and allowable bearing capacity of strip, square, circular and rectangular footings with the Terzaghi, Meyerhof and Vesić methods, including shape, depth and inclination factors and the effect of the water table.
- [Pile Capacity · قدرة تحمل الركائز](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/pile-capacity/): Calculates the axial compression capacity of a single bored or driven pile through any sequence of clay and sand layers with the methods used in practice: the α-method in clay, the β-method in sand with limiting values, and end bearing at the tip. It shows the friction and the cumulative capacity with depth, the capacity against pile length, the allowable load with the chosen factor of safety and the shortest pile that carries a given working load.
- [Settlement and Consolidation · الهبوط والانضمام](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/settlement/): Distributes the footing pressure into the ground with Boussinesq theory, adds the immediate settlement of every layer and the primary consolidation of the clay layers from their compression index, void ratio and preconsolidation pressure, and follows the settlement with time by Terzaghi’s theory. It shows the stresses with depth, the depth of influence that boreholes must reach, the settlement curve against time and the share of each layer.
- [Slope Stability · ثبات المنحدرات](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/slope-stability/): Searches hundreds of circular slip surfaces through a slope and finds the one with the lowest factor of safety by the simplified Bishop method, checked against the ordinary method of slices. The slope can carry a surcharge on its crest, sit on a firm layer, hold a water table or a pore-pressure ratio, and be shaken by an earthquake. A second search over slope angles gives the steepest face that meets the required factor of safety.
- [Retaining Walls · الجدران الساندة](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/retaining-wall/): Computes the active earth pressure behind a cantilever or gravity wall by Rankine or Coulomb theory, adds the surcharge, the Mononobe–Okabe seismic increment and the inertia of the wall, and checks the wall against overturning, sliding, eccentricity and bearing pressure with the factors of safety used in design practice. The section is drawn to scale with the pressure diagrams, the forces and the contact pressure under the base, and every force and moment is listed.
- [Soil Liquefaction · تميّع التربة](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/liquefaction/): Applies the Idriss & Boulanger SPT procedure to every test of a borehole: it corrects the blow counts for hammer energy, rods, borehole and sampler, overburden and fines, compares the cyclic stress of the design earthquake with the cyclic resistance of the sand, and gives the factor of safety at each depth. It adds the liquefaction potential index, the thickness that liquefies and the settlement of the ground after shaking, and places every test on the classic chart of case histories.
- [Mohr Circle & Failure Envelope · دائرة مور وغلاف الانهيار](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/mohr-circle/): Draws the Mohr circle for any 2-D stress state, gives principal stresses, maximum shear and the stresses on any plane, checks it against a Mohr–Coulomb envelope, and fits c and φ from a series of triaxial tests.
- [Atterberg Limits & Plasticity · حدود أتربرغ واللدونة](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/atterberg-limits/): Fits the Casagrande flow curve to find the liquid limit at 25 blows, combines it with the plastic limit, and reports plasticity, liquidity, consistency and activity indices with the USCS fine-grained class on the plasticity chart.
- [Grain-Size Analysis · التحليل الحجمي الحبيبي](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/grain-size/): Turns sieve masses into a particle-size distribution curve, reads D10, D30 and D60, computes uniformity and curvature coefficients, classifies the soil with USCS, and gives Folk & Ward graphic statistics for sedimentology.
- [Engineering Soil Classification · التصنيف الهندسي للتربة](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/soil-classification/): Classifies a soil sample by the two systems used in engineering reports: the Unified Soil Classification System (ASTM D2487) with its full group names and modifiers, and the AASHTO system (M 145) with the group index used for roads. It reads the gravel, sand and fines fractions, D10, D30, D60, Cu and Cc from the gradation, places the fines on the plasticity chart and states what the soil is good for.
- [Compaction and CBR · الرص ونسبة تحمل كاليفورنيا](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/compaction-cbr/): Turns the raw readings of a Proctor test into the compaction curve, with the maximum dry density, the optimum water content, the zero-air-voids and saturation lines and the degree of saturation at optimum, then checks a field density test against the specification. The CBR part draws the load–penetration curve, corrects a concave start, gives the CBR at 2.54 and 5.08 mm, rates the material for road layers and estimates its resilient modulus.
- [3-D Surface Plotter · مُرسِم الأسطح ثلاثية الأبعاد](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/surface-3d/): Turns a table of samples into a three-dimensional response surface of one property against two others, as in published laboratory studies: classed colour surface with grid lines and a projected map on its base, a contour map with the samples, simple and multiple regression equations with R², and a written interpretation.

### Terrain & maps · التضاريس والخرائط
- [DEM & Contour Mapping Studio · استوديو نموذج الارتفاع الرقمي والخرائط الكنتورية](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/dem-studio/): Mark any area on Earth and the studio fetches a digital elevation model as a regular grid in UTM or geographic coordinates, traces contours at the interval you choose, and lays out a print-ready map in five styles, from colour relief to a spot-height exercise sheet. It cuts topographic profiles, builds a 3D model, computes the hypsometric curve, integral and slope distribution, and exports the grid and contours for Surfer, QGIS, ArcGIS and AutoCAD Civil 3D.
- [2D Contour Mapping Lab · مختبر الخرائط الكنتورية ثنائية الأبعاد](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/contour-lab/): Load X, Y, Z points from a total station, GPS, boreholes or any spatial variable, interpolate them by ordinary kriging or inverse distance, and lay out a print-ready contour map with variogram and cross-validation.
- [Geomorphological & Contour Survey · المسح الجيومورفولوجي والكنتوري](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/geomorphology-contour/): Turns GPS points taken across a site and along a wadi into a kriged contour map in UTM, a longitudinal channel profile with gradient and sinuosity, and a written interpretation joined with your field geomorphology.

### Geophysics · الجيوفيزياء
- [Regional Magnetic Lab · المختبر المغناطيسي الإقليمي](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/magnetic-lab/): Computes the IGRF-14 main field in your browser for any area, epoch and height, and reduces ground magnetometer readings to a residual anomaly with diurnal correction, kriged into a contour map.
- [Well Log Lab · مختبر المجسات البئرية](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/well-log-lab/): Load well logs as LAS, Excel or CSV files, type the readings, or trace a printed log from an image. The lab recognises the curves of the main service companies, draws the composite log in the standard layout and interprets it: shale volume, porosity, mineral volumes, water saturation, gas, oil and water, invaded permeable beds, bad hole, fracture candidates, source rocks, layer boundaries and net pay — or, in water wells, aquifers and their salinity. Crossplots, well correlation, a response chart of every log and a guide to all the common logs complete it.
- [Thermal Maturity & Geothermal Lab · مختبر الطاقة الحرارية الأرضية والنضج الحراري](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/geothermal-lab/): Computes the geothermal gradient from formation and surface temperatures, and places samples in the oil or gas window using vitrinite reflectance and Rock-Eval Tmax.
- [Vertical Electrical Sounding Lab · مختبر السبر الكهربائي العمودي](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/ves-lab/): Turns the field readings of a resistivity sounding into apparent resistivity, joins the curve segments measured with different potential electrode spacings, and inverts the curve to a model of two to six horizontal layers by damped least squares with an exact forward solution of the layered earth. Each layer gets its thickness, depth and true resistivity with an uncertainty, an interpretation in terms of rock, clay and water, and the Dar Zarrouk parameters. Soundings saved along a line are joined into a geoelectric section.

### Water & rivers · المياه والأنهار
- [Hydrochemistry Water Lab · مختبر هيدروكيمياء المياه](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/water-lab/): Enter the major-ion analysis of surface or groundwater samples. The lab checks the ionic balance, classifies each sample on the Piper, Gibbs, Schoeller, Stiff and USSL diagrams, evaluates drinking quality against the Iraqi standard IQS 417 or the WHO guidelines with two water-quality indices, rates irrigation suitability with six indices and FAO classes, and writes the hydrochemical interpretation.
- [Hydrological Early Warning · الإنذار الهيدرولوجي المبكر](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/hydro-alert/): Fetches hourly rainfall for any point, observed and forecast, tests every window from 1 hour to 10 days against published intensity–duration thresholds, tracks antecedent wetness and reads the local slope from a global DEM.
- [Water Through the Decades: Surface Water Atlas · المياه عبر العقود: أطلس المياه السطحية](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/water-occurrence/): The global surface-water atlas classifies every Landsat image from March 1984 to 2020, more than three million scenes, into water and land. For any area up to 150 km across this tool shows how often each pixel was water, what happened to it between the first and the last years (permanent, new permanent, lost permanent, seasonal, new and lost seasonal, seasonal to permanent and the reverse), how water occurrence changed between 1984–1999 and 2000–2020, and how many months it was wet in 2020, with every area in km². It is also the reference against which the Earth Through Time tool can be checked.
- [Watershed and Morphometry Lab · مختبر الأحواض المائية والتحليل المورفومتري](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/watershed-lab/): Delineates the drainage basin upstream of any point from a global elevation model, extracts the stream network and orders it by Strahler, and computes the standard morphometric parameters of Horton, Strahler, Schumm and Miller: areal, linear and relief aspects, hypsometry and the longest flow path. The time of concentration and the flood hydrograph of a design storm follow from the NRCS curve number and unit hydrograph. Results are drawn as a finished basin map with its figures, and the boundary and streams are exported for GIS.
- [Groundwater Potential Zones · مناطق احتمالية المياه الجوفية](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/potential-zones/): Draw an area and the tool builds a groundwater potential map from lithology, lineament density, slope, drainage density, rainfall, topographic wetness, land cover and dry-season moisture, vegetation and surface temperature. Each layer is rated 1–5, weighted by the analytic hierarchy process, and the map is classed into five zones and validated against known wells.

### Atmosphere & air quality · الغلاف الجوي وجودة الهواء
- [Air Quality Monitor · مراقب جودة الهواء](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/air-quality/): Shows current and forecast air quality for any point from the Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service: US and European AQI, PM2.5, PM10, dust, NO₂, SO₂, O₃, CO and aerosol optical depth, compared with the WHO 2021 guidelines, plus a regional AQI map.
- [Gas Flaring and Air over Oil Fields · حرق الغاز والهواء فوق حقول النفط](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/gas-flaring/): Iraq burns more of the gas that comes up with its oil than almost any other country. This tool reads the VIIRS thermal anomalies of every day of a chosen month at 375 m, counts how many days each pixel was hot, and keeps as gas flares the hot spots that burned on a chosen share of the days, which separates them from passing crop and reed fires. Neighbouring flare pixels are grouped into sites with their position, nearest known field and number of days burning. The daily OMI images of tropospheric nitrogen dioxide of the month are turned back into values with their published colour map and averaged, and the air above the flares is compared with the whole region. Maps, a table, GeoJSON and CSV are exported.

### Climate & emissions · المناخ والانبعاثات
- [Environmental Monitoring & Modelling · الرصد الفضائي والنمذجة البيئية](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/env-monitoring/): Live weather and air quality for the site turned into field guidance: WBGT heat stress, atmospheric stability, a Gaussian plume model for a nearby source, a weighted water-quality index with concrete sulfate class, and the MEDALUS desertification index.
- [Urban Heat and Drought Watch · حرارة المدن ومراقبة الجفاف](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/heat-drought/): Two studies from the MODIS sensor on Terra. Urban heat island: the land-surface temperature of a chosen month at 1 km, day and night, averaged over its 8-day composites and compared between the built-up area and the countryside around it, which are taken from the annual 10 m land-cover map; with the heat-island intensity, the hottest built-up places and temperature against the share of buildings. Drought: the 250 m greenness (NDVI) of a chosen month in every year since 2001, turned into the vegetation condition index, with drought classes and their areas, the anomaly from the usual greenness, and the greenness of that month year by year.

### Natural hazards · المخاطر الطبيعية
- [Natural Hazards Monitor · مراقب المخاطر الطبيعية](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/hazards-monitor/): Shows live earthquakes, tsunami-flagged shocks, volcanic unrest, wildfires, storms and tropical cyclones, floods, drought, dust storms, landslides, sea and lake ice, heavy snow, temperature extremes, water-colour events and human-caused events, with daily satellite images of active fires, dust and smoke, rain rate, flood water and land-surface temperature, over plate boundaries, active faults and Holocene volcanoes.
- [Flood Radar: Floods Through the Clouds · رادار الفيضانات: الفيضان من خلال الغيوم](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/flood-radar/): Floods come with clouds, so optical satellites rarely see them. Radar does: it sends its own microwave signal, which passes through cloud and works at night, and calm water reflects it away so it looks dark. Choose a place anywhere on Earth and the day of the flood; the tool takes the first Sentinel-1 pass after it and a dry reference made of up to three earlier passes from the same orbit, finds the water in both with an automatic threshold, confirms new water by the drop in backscatter, leaves out steep slopes with an elevation model, and maps the flooded land, the permanent water and the water that went back with their true areas. It can follow the flood through every radar pass from a month before to six weeks after, and exports the maps, the flood polygons and the numbers.
- [Landslide Susceptibility · قابلية الانزلاقات الأرضية](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/landslide-susceptibility/): Draw an area and the tool ranks the ground from very low to very high susceptibility to landslides from nine evidence layers: slope, rock and soil type, the heavy-rain day, the strongest earthquake shaking on record, distance to lineaments, distance to streams, plan curvature, vegetation and land cover. The layers are weighted by the analytic hierarchy process and the map is checked against mapped landslides.
- [Volcanoes of the World · براكين العالم](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/volcanoes/): Maps the world’s Holocene volcanoes from the Smithsonian Global Volcanism Program with type, elevation, tectonic setting and last known eruption, highlights volcanoes active now from NASA EONET, and finds the volcanoes nearest to any site.

### Petroleum laboratories · مختبرات البترول
- [Kerogen Analysis Lab · مختبر تحليل الكيروجين](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/kerogen-lab/): Calculates hydrogen, oxygen and production indices from Rock-Eval pyrolysis, estimates vitrinite-equivalent maturity from Tmax, and plots samples on HI–TOC, pseudo-Van Krevelen and HI–Tmax diagrams.
- [Palynofacies Lab · مختبر السحنات البالينولوجية](https://geologicalfieldsurvey.com/tools/palynofacies-lab/): Plots AOM, phytoclast and palynomorph counts on Tyson’s (1995) ternary diagram and reads off the palynofacies field, depositional setting and kerogen character.

## Frequently asked questions
- Do I need to install anything? No. The system runs in the browser on your phone, tablet or computer. Location and motion sensors are used only when a tool asks for them.
- هل أحتاج إلى تثبيت أي برنامج؟ لا. يعمل النظام في متصفح الهاتف أو الجهاز اللوحي أو الحاسوب، وتُستخدم حساسات الموقع والحركة فقط عندما تطلبها الأداة.
- Does it work without internet in the field? You need a connection to sign in and to load maps and satellite data. Calculations and report export continue to work once a tool is open.
- هل يعمل دون إنترنت في الحقل؟ تحتاج إلى اتصال لتسجيل الدخول وتحميل الخرائط والبيانات الفضائية، ثم تستمر الحسابات وتصدير التقارير بعد فتح الأداة.
- How do I pay? Prices are in US dollars. Inside Iraq pay the equivalent in Iraqi dinars by ZainCash; from abroad send a Western Union transfer. Send us the transfer number (MTCN) or a photo of the receipt and your account is activated within three hours.
- كيف أدفع؟ الأسعار بالدولار الأمريكي. من داخل العراق ادفع ما يعادلها بالدينار العراقي عبر زين كاش، ومن خارج العراق أرسل حوالة ويسترن يونيون. أرسل لنا رقم الحوالة (MTCN) أو صورة الوصل ويُفعَّل حسابك خلال ثلاث ساعات.
- Can a university or company subscribe for a team? Yes. Institutional plans include several accounts and training. Send us the number of users.
- هل يمكن لجامعة أو شركة الاشتراك لفريق؟ نعم. تشمل خطط المؤسسات عدة حسابات وتدريباً. أرسل لنا عدد المستخدمين.
- Can the results be used in official reports? Yes, as supporting analysis. Final engineering decisions must be signed by a qualified, licensed professional.
- هل يمكن استخدام النتائج في التقارير الرسمية؟ نعم، كتحليل داعم. يجب أن يوقّع القرارات الهندسية النهائية مختص مؤهل ومرخّص.
